core.name: Thief of Flames
core.text:
Each point of initial Anomaly Mastery above 150 gives +1.5 Anomaly Proficiency and +0.35% squad Abloom DMG.
Her hits build Corrosive Chill (max 100), plus 5 for squad Freeze, Disorder or Vortex, 10 for Shrouded in Shadow, and 15 for any squad Abloom. Every 50 becomes 1 Trial by Cold (max 2); she enters battle with 2.
Merciless Judgment spends 1 Trial by Cold; its finisher on an Anomaly-afflicted enemy triggers Abloom for {0}% of that Anomaly's DMG.
Her Abloom hits give 100 Decibels (once per 0.5s). Frost Oath (from her Ultimate, max 1): after Merciless Judgment, Chain or Ultimate, press to spend it on Layered Frost.

ability.name: Vessel of Ice
ability.text: EX Special gives +30% Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate for 30s. Frostbite from anyone lasts 3s longer. Her EX hits apply Presumption of Guilt for 30s: any squad Abloom on that enemy ignores 40% DEF.

mindscapes: Her Ultimate gives 1 Trial by Cold if not full. Abloom on Presumption of Guilt targets ignores 20% more DEF.
+40 Anomaly Proficiency. Trial by Cold Ablooms get +120% multiplier.
Her Ablooms restore 5 Corrosive Chill (once per 0.5s).
Trial by Cold Ablooms add a special 200% Abloom, 5 Corrosive Chill and 100 Decibels (once per 15s). Her Anomaly and Disorder DMG ignore 15% All-Attribute RES.
